name: Si Diao de Nu'er
source:
In Chenglian, countless unborn and newborn daughters are killed every year.

This is the story of the birth of Xu Shu, the protagonist of The Wind Knocks at the Door, and the story of her two sets of parents, a short prequel.

Are you afraid of your dead daughter?
